output.review_comment: The code changes implement standard title case rules correctly: preserving mixed-case words, capitalizing first and last words regardless of small-word status, and treating words after colons as start positions. The logic is sound with proper handling of edge cases. The implementation correctly tracks colon position for the following iteration and properly detects small words after removing trailing punctuation. While a PR description explaining the fix would be helpful (to confirm docstring alignment and test passage), the code itself appears correct and ready to merge.
